_meta.purpose: Ground truth for the 2026-10-07 e2e journey extraction scorecard. Layer 1 = text-fidelity checks evaluated against pypdf text extracted from the exact uploaded bytes (same fixtures, same host pypdf). Layer 2 (layer2/normalized) = expected journey extraction outputs from the generator's completed-document constants.

check_types.presence: needle must occur in normalized text
check_types.assoc: needle must occur within w chars after anchor occurrence
check_types.pre: needle must occur with exact prefix p (number line) immediately before it
check_types.forbid_win: regex rx must NOT match inside window (from anchor, delimited by end anchor or w chars); strip removes the printed Yes/No label pair before testing
